title_en: Seeing the Sky from the Well
page_text_en: Sitting in a Well and Watching the Sky
summary_zh: 本页展示了绘本标题“坐井观天”，画面中一只青蛙坐在井底的石头上，背景是井壁和井底的水与植物。

title_en: Seeing the Sky from the Well
page_text_en: A frog sits in the well.
summary_zh: 画面展示了一只青蛙坐在井底的石头上，周围是井壁和少量植物，下方文字说明‘一只青蛙坐在井里’。

title_en: Seeing the Sky from the Well
page_text_ocr_zh: 一只小鸟飞来，落在井沿上
page_text_en: A little bird flew over and landed on the edge of the well.
summary_zh: 一只小鸟飞来，落在井沿上，画面展示了一个绿意盎然的户外场景，井口周围有树木、花草和灌木。

title_en: Seeing the Sky from the Well
page_text_ocr_zh: 青蛙问小鸟，你从哪儿来呀？
page_text_en: The frog asked the bird, 'Where are you from?'
summary_zh: 青蛙坐在井底，抬头问落在井沿上的小鸟从哪里来。

title_en: Seeing the Sky from the Well
page_text_ocr_zh: 小鸟回答说，我从天上来，我飞了一百多里。口渴了，下来找点水喝。
page_text_en: The little bird replied, 'I came from up in the sky. I flew over a hundred li. I'm thirsty, so I came down to find some water to drink.'
summary_zh: 小鸟回答青蛙，它从天上飞来，飞行了一百多里，因为口渴所以来井边找水喝。

title_en: Seeing the Sky from the Well
page_text_ocr_zh: 青蛙说，朋友别说大话了
page_text_en: The frog said, 'Friend, don't talk big.'
summary_zh: 青蛙对小鸟的话表示怀疑，认为它在说大话。

title_en: Seeing the Sky from the Well
page_text_ocr_zh: 天不过井口那么大，还用飞那么远吗？
page_text_en: The sky is no bigger than the well's mouth. Why fly so far?
summary_zh: 青蛙从井底向上看，认为天空只有井口那么大，质疑小鸟为何要飞那么远来喝水。

title_en: Seeing the Sky from the Well
page_text_ocr_zh: 小鸟说，你弄错了，天无边无际，大得很那。
page_text_en: The bird said, 'You're wrong. The sky is boundless and very big.'
summary_zh: 小鸟向青蛙解释天空无边无际，非常大，纠正了青蛙对天空大小的错误认知。

title_en: Seeing the Sky from the Well
page_text_ocr_zh: 青蛙笑了，说：‘朋友，我天天坐在井里。’
page_text_en: The frog smiled and said, 'Friend, I sit in the well every day.'
summary_zh: 青蛙坐在井底的石头上，笑着对小鸟说它天天都待在井里。

title_en: Seeing the Sky from the Well
page_text_ocr_zh: 一抬头就看见天，我不会弄错的。
page_text_en: As soon as I lift my head, I can see the sky. I won't be wrong.
summary_zh: 青蛙坐在井底的石头上，自信地表示自己抬头就能看见天，不会弄错，坚持自己对天空大小的认知。

title_en: Seeing the Sky from the Well
page_text_ocr_zh: 小鸟也笑了，说，朋友，你是弄错了，不信，你跳出井口来看一看吧
page_text_en: The little bird smiled and said, 'Friend, you're wrong. If you don't believe me, jump out of the well and take a look.'
summary_zh: 小鸟笑着对青蛙说它弄错了，建议青蛙跳出井口亲自看看天空的真相。
